info.title: lockflight — gated delivery engine for Claude Code agents
info.description: Lockflight engine for Claude Code agents on .NET projects: deterministic quality gates (format, build, test, patch coverage, vulnerable dependencies, secrets), protected paths enforced by Claude Code hooks, and a spec-driven lifecycle with hash-bound approvals, red/green test-first evidence, requirement trace and an evidence-bound review of record.
